findings.summary: likeness_reference renders were judged by the portrait standard, whose PASS clause requires facing the camera and a warm expression -- four of the five variants are prompted for neutral expressions or three-quarter turns, and a refusal there is permanent.

one over-long brief field made the writer refuse all four, and the service falls back to a single plain brief for the whole set -- so a setting twenty characters long cost four good briefs and produced four identical plain pictures.
the setting joined the prompt in lower case immediately after a full stop, and the coverage rule re-offered trousers after the brief had already dressed her in a dress.
a malformed omniai_appearance was swallowed, so her age, gender and build vanished from the brief input and she was dressed without them with nothing saying so.
